title: Do concept vectors for the same safety concept agree across different open model families?

original_idea.body: Extract ~3 safety concept vectors across 3-4 open families, measure cross-family probe detection and steering transferability, and report a cross-family agreement matrix.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: cross-family universality affects scalability of safety tooling, but link has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Extract across 3-4 families; cross-family alignment is subtle.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Ecosystem-scalability mapping on open models, weak lab incentive.

novelty.reasoning: Cross-model transfer reported; cross-family geometric agreement may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Cross-family universality matrix may be partly open.
